text:
Marathon Petroleum gained nearly half a percent today to $424.02, continuing a strong two-week rally that has lifted the stock 9.4% since early September. The timing aligns with a sharp rebound in oil prices: U.S. crude has climbed to $107 per barrel, and refineries are running at 96.8% capacity—near-maximum utilization. Higher oil prices typically benefit refiners by expanding the margin between what they pay for crude and what they earn selling refined products like gasoline and diesel.

The broader rally reflects easing supply concerns in a tense geopolitical environment. Though Saudi Arabia faced a pipeline outage from Houthi attacks and the Middle East conflict has escalated, the market has largely shrugged off worst-case disruption scenarios after Saudi Arabia signaled it would supply more crude through alternative routes. With diesel prices at record levels and refineries running hot, the refining sector is capturing strong demand and pricing power across the economy.
